title: Scope generic queries and content access to the authorized tenant
description:
As a project member, I want generic issue queries to respect my authorized scope so another tenant cannot read or modify my records.

Feature: Tenant-safe generic queries
  Scenario: Reject cross-tenant record access
    Given two tenants with records and object references
    When a member of one tenant supplies another tenant's issue ID, object pointer or cursor
    Then the request is rejected without exposing content or changing records
  Scenario: Apply ordinary Kanbus filters
    Given mixed issue types, statuses, assignees, parents and labels in the authorized project
    When a client applies the supported generic predicates and configured scalar field comparisons
    Then only matching scoped records are returned in the declared order
    And pagination preserves that query's scope and semantics
  Scenario: Observe a recently committed write
    Given a successful canonical mutation whose query projection has not converged
    When the writer reloads that issue directly
    Then the committed revision is available
    And query freshness is reported without promising immediate catalog convergence
  Scenario: Continue a filtered page
    Given a filtered query page with no matches and a continuation cursor
    When the client requests remaining pages
    Then later matching records are not silently omitted
